newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SEC to open electronic filing Saturday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SEC to open electronic filing Saturday.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said Friday it will open its electronic filing facilities for six hours on Saturday to help companies meet their March 31 deadlines to file annual reports.

The Electronic Data Gathering And Retrieval (EDGAR) system will be open from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. EST (1300 to 1900 GMT) on Saturday to give extra filing time to companies filing annual reports on Forms 10-K and 10-KSB, the SEC said.

"This step is being taken to accommodate filers in view of the fact that a large number of these reports are due March 31 and many companies will be filing these annual reports electronically for the first time," the SEC said.
Filings received and processed Saturday will be assigned a March 31 filing date and will not be disseminated until 8 a.m. EST (1300 GMT) on Monday, it said.
